text: צְמִידִים֙ עַל־יָדֶ֔יהָ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מִשְׁקָלָֽם׃ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בַּת־
translation: and two gold bands for her arms, ten shekels in weight. “Pray tell me,” he

text: מִ֣י אַ֔תְּ הַגִּ֥ידִי נָ֖א לִ֑י הֲיֵ֧שׁ בֵּית־אָבִ֛יךְ מָק֥וֹם לָ֖נוּ לָלִֽין׃
translation: said, “whose daughter are you? Is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
